name: NSW Transport Concession Entitlement Card for apprentices
summary: Apprentices and new entrant trainees registered in NSW get concession Opal fares and concession fares on regional buses.

evidence.quote: are entitled to receive a Transport Concession Entitlement card.
With a Transport Concession Entitlement Card outside the Opal network, you pay concession fares on local bus services.
Existing worker trainees are not eligible.
